findings: Current note distinguishes Full Speed12Mbps from High Speed480Mbps; clock accuracy/power/ESD remain relevant
45ohm +/-10% note describes a full-speed driver within a high-speed driver, not qualification of current PCB differential impedance
No examined text establishes permission to ignore current reference-plane discontinuities solely because traces are short or Full Speed
